static_traits.name: Li Li安
static_traits.social_status: 与Male友关系整体Good；通常会在遇到困难时与朋友交流，但这次not yet向朋友分享not安全感与Anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史；not yet接受过心理咨询或心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高、能进行自我Reflection；主观感受紧张但抱有希望

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直对与Male友共同参加的舞蹈课感到Anxiety和not安全感；我有一种非理性的信念，认为因为舞蹈课进展not顺利，他会离开我。
basic_info.core_demands: 因在与Male友的舞蹈课中出现的关系not安全感与Anxiety日益加重而寻求支持，希望缓解这些问题并获得更均衡的看法与应对方式。

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/not够好
如果关系出现not顺，I will be abandoned

special_situations.event: 在与Male友的舞蹈课中出现步伐出错、配合not佳
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我们在舞蹈上not顺利，就说明我们的关系出了问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly overthinking and rehearsing the worst case before and after class, trying to obtain a sense of control through worrying in advance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他会因为我们跳得not好而离开我

special_situations.event: 在Male友与教练面前担心失败与被评价
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在他和教练面前失败，他会认为I am not competent enough、关系是个错误
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在课程中高度Self-monitoring、尽量避免失误以防被negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他一定觉得这段关系是个错误

special_situations.event: Before each dance class, thinks of previous mistakes and infers overall performance from them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次或几次表现not佳就意味着我们今后都会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on mistakes to 'remind' themselves to improve, ignoring neutral or positive information

special_situations.event: 在课程中忽视Male友的鼓励与积极反馈，聚焦于出错之处
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈not代表真实情况，错误才说明问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极信号，以自我苛责来促使改进
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他的鼓励只是安慰，我其实not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be steadily accepted and affirmed in intimate relationships and to be securely attached
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged and rejected for failure, ultimately being abandoned and falling into isolation
defense_goal: 通过提前Anticipation最坏、读心与过度Self-monitoring来避免被伤害与被negate

object_relations.self_representation: not够胜任、容易出错、需要被认可的自我
object_relations.object_representation: A partner who is supportive on the surface but imagined as a potential judge / rejecter

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当在舞蹈课中出现失误或感到被Male友/教练关注与评价时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自身的not安Projection为对方的负面看法：认为对方把关系视为错误并可能离开自己（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以not确定且紧张的语气表达担忧，频繁use“他会not会…”的猜测性句式，寻求保证与安抚。

manifestations: Strongly fears being abandoned, equating mistakes in dance class with relationship failure
对他人（Male友）如何看待自己高度在意与猜测
outcomes: 在每次舞蹈课前后Anticipation最坏结果，整体心情受影响，关系受压

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在课程中高度Self-monitoring、害怕失误
过度担心被伴侣与教练评价
以灾难化方式预演最坏结果

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为Male友把关系视为错误、会离开自己（读心）
将自身not安解释为对方的负面看法

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 虽有朋友支持网络，但这次have not向朋友分享Anxiety与not安
Bears stress inwardly, copes through self-blame

positive_force: The partner continuously encourages and supports during the course (persisting in attending class, praising small progress)
Can notice and name cognitive patterns, willing to try a more balanced perspective
Actively seeks counseling, positive attitude、愿意尝试行为实验
具备朋友支持网络（尽管not yet在此次问题上求助）
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, overgeneralization, and mental filtering
对失败高度敏感，将表现not佳直接等同于关系质量下降
过度Self-monitoring与自我苛责，过分在意他人评价
对Loneliness与被抛弃的恐惧Reinforcement了not良解释循环

target_behavior.behavior: 在与Male友共同参加舞蹈课时的Significant anxiety与not安全感
antecedent: 出现步伐出错或配合not佳
Under the gaze and evaluation of the coach or partner
target_behavior.core_reason: 将舞蹈表现与关系质量直接等同的认知偏差（灾难化、读心、预测not yet来、过度泛化），并伴随对被评判与被抛弃的恐惧
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪并寻求安全感；通过提前Anticipation最坏来尝试获得控制与保证
target_behavior.consequence: 每次课程前后均出现Significant anxiety，整体情绪与Decreased enjoyment of life，关系受到额外压力
